 EL PASO, Texas (KFOX 14, CBS 4) — Raina Tomasicka scored 26 points off the bench to lead the New Mexico State Aggies to a 69-50 victory over the UTEP Miners at the GECU Arena at the Don Haskins Center on Tuesday. 
 NMSU moves to 2-1. UTEP falls to 2-1. 
 UTEP started off the game hot and led 13-12 after the first quarter. In the second quarter, Tomasicka knocked down a three pointer to put the Aggies up 21-19 and they never trailed the rest of the way. The Aggies opened the second half with a 9-2 run and cruised the rest of the way. 
 For NMSU, Tomasicka scored the 26 points and had four rebounds and three steals. She shot 7 of 12 from the floor and 4 of 7 from three-point range. 
 Aimee Michel scored 17 points and had four rebounds, while shooting 7 of 13 on FG.
 For UTEP, Armanda Sindalawa scored 17 points. 
 Imani Warren, who transferred to UTEP from NMSU in the summer, scored seven points and had two assists. 
 On Saturday, UTEP will host Alabama State. On Monday, NMSU will host Kansas City.
